CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 42
   C. 21
   D. 30

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 60

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 34
   C. 22
   D. 66

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 15
   D. 30

13. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 24.5
   C. 7
   D. 8

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 25

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

16. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

17. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 36
   C. 7
   D. 18

18. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

19. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 22
   C. 19
   D. 88

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 30
   C. 46
   D. 23

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

23. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 19

24. Solve for x: x + 7 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 11
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
